pr3: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
Speaks to trusting God when the way forward is unclear.
ph4: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God. And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.
Addresses anxiety, prayer, and bringing concerns before God.
ps23: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.
Speaks of God’s presence in the hardest seasons.
is41: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
A promise of God’s presence and help to those who are afraid.
mt11: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
An invitation to bring weariness and heavy burdens to Jesus.
ps34: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.
Speaks of God being near to the brokenhearted.
ep4: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ’s sake hath forgiven you.
Addresses forgiveness and kindness in relationships.
mt6: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
Speaks to priorities when worried about daily needs.
ph419: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
jm1: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
Encourages asking God for wisdom when deciding.
co10: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.
Addresses temptation and God’s faithfulness in it.
jn3: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
Speaks of God’s love and the heart of the gospel.
ro8: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
Speaks of God’s purposes in uncertain circumstances.
jo1: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.
Encourages courage because God is present.
ps46: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
Speaks of God as a refuge in trouble.
ps119: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
Speaks of Scripture giving light for the next step.
jm4: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you.
Speaks of drawing near to God.
th5: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
Speaks of gratitude in all circumstances.
